summary: Full-stack testing of Μαθηματικά Γυμνασίου (React+FastAPI+MongoDB). Backend: 6/6 pytest passed for /api/grades, /api/lessons, single-grade, single-lesson (g7-1-1 correct=2, options[2]='600'), and 404 for unknown ids. Frontend: Home hero+stats, search ('κλάσματα' → 7 results), filter pills (7), theme toggle (light↔dark), grade card → /grade/g7 shows 21 lessons, lesson g7-1-1 renders theory+example+KaTeX (no raw LaTeX), quiz flow: start → answer options → feedback → next-question → final score (data-testid quiz-score displays 'Απάντησες σωστά X από N ερωτήσεις'), retry/back-grade-result/next-lesson buttons all present, Achievements page shows 4 StatBox + 8 badges (locked initially), reset button + confirm flow works and clears progress.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Grade endpoint /api/grades/{id} could use response_model like others for consistency (currently returns dict).
Seed runs on every startup (upsert). Fine for MVP but could gate behind env flag in production.
seed_data_creation: None; backend auto-seeds 3 grades + 47 lessons on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ covers all 4 endpoints + 404s. Frontend fully verified via Playwright: home search/filter/theme/grade nav, lesson quiz e2e with KaTeX, achievements badges (8) + reset. Note: Achievements badges use framer-motion animation delays; add ~1.5s wait after nav to /achievements before querying [data-testid^='badge-'] elements.
